infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Huzz uses your camera for 18+ age verification, Live video chat, and club voice spaces.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Huzz uses the microphone for Live video chat and club voice spaces.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Huzz needs your location (city/region) to show nearby matches and keep the community safe. Location is required to use the app.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Optional: import contacts in Settings if you want to block people you know from finding you on Huzz.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Huzz uses your photo library when you choose a profile photo or share an image in chat.
